title: Three Years and One Short Page
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：meaning　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 meaning 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the scholar ① found the meaning that no pupil in the study would have recorded, and he said the finding was the whole of the year. The ② meaning, meaning the sense itself and not the page, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a meaning, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ meaning in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ meaning at the far shelf, meaning the word they kept for the children to look up and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A meaning, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the scholar said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the meaning was the whole of the matter, meaning the point and not the sense. The ⑥ meaning, meaning the point and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; meaning, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a sense and a point. He said the point is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ meaning had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ meaning of the whole thing, the scholar wrote in January, was one study and three years of recording; meaning, he said, is either the word at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ meaning I remember is the sense recorded in the note, which closed in 1966 and is still recorded as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ meaning, my mother said in 1968, is the only sense that improves by being recorded; every meaning, she said, is a point that has agreed to look like a sense. She said the point was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 意思；含义（指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 意思；含义（指那个含义本身，与书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the meaning 找出这个意思
D. n. 意思；含义（指留给孩子们查的那一个那一个）
E. n. 释义之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的意思之事）
F. n. 意思；含义（指札记里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 要旨、深意（指一件事里人人都问却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 深意（抽象总称，指人人都问却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: found the meaning that no pupil in the study would have recorded
The meaning, meaning the sense itself and not the page
the meaning at the far shelf

answers.why: find the meaning 意为“找出这个意思”，1959 年那位学者把书斋里没有一位门生肯记下的一个意思做了一遍。
meaning 意为“意思；含义”，指那个含义本身而不是书页，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
meaning 意为“意思；含义”，指书斋里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
meaning 意为“意思；含义”，指最远那层书架留给孩子们查的那一个那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
meaning 意为“要旨、深意”，指一件事里人人都问却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个要旨就是那件事的全部。
meaning 意为“深意”，指人人都问却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个含义，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
meaning 意为“意思；含义”，指札记里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1964 年这一个成了札记里的一行。
meaning 意为“释义之事”，学者一月写道，整件事的意思之事是一处书斋和三个年头的记下。
meaning 意为“意思；含义”，我记得的是札记里记下过的那一个，1966 年讲完了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一个。
meaning 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，意思是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的含义。
